question.text: Unpolarized light of intensity <math><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></math> is incident on surface of a block of glass at Brewster's angle. In that case, which one of the following statements is true?

options.text: transmitted light is partially polarized with intensity <math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>
transmitted light is completely polarized with intensity less than <math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>
reflected light is partially polarized with intensity <math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>
reflected light is completely polarized with intensity less than <math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>

solution.text: By polarizations due to reflection at a polarising angle reflected light is completely polarise and the intensity is less than average intensity <math><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math>.
